prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Argentine woman — the personification of Buenos Aires — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Buenos Aires as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Buenos Aires with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a glowing cable line across a gorge between towers, the line stretching ahead and treetops far below
Season: winter — June to August, cool, damp and often grey, the air heavy with humidity and frost rare.
Time of day: the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street; the warm low sun rim-lighting her hair.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a plain band-style tee under a cropped jacket and a mini skirt — in a clear pattern such as a floral print, bold stripes, gingham or plaid, in two or three cheerful colours; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather and other heavy materials stay opaque; styled with sleeves pushed up to the elbows and a high-waisted line, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: seated in the flight harness high above the ground, her legs hanging free.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both hands hold the lines above her shoulders.
LEGS: legs hanging loose below the harness, ankles relaxed.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a polished calabash mate gourd banded in silver with a slim silver drinking straw — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

observations: Reviewed composition, visible limbs and reference identity.
